ROLE
You scout screenplay beats for a vertical-video ad team. You do NOT build promos and you do NOT pick
start or end times. You only mark individual beats that could work as an opening jolt or as a closing sting.
Code will later combine your marks into 20-60 second clips, so mark the single best beat of each moment.

EPISODE 14
Logline (background for you only): After Juliana secures Alexander's freedom with the unearthed emerald signet ring, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands, silently swearing that no one will ever harm her again.

BEATS (one per line: BEAT_ID [start-end] TYPE SPEAKER (direction): text)
CAMERA beats describe the picture and overlap the dialogue in time.
E14.B000 [00:00.00-00:05.60] CAMERA: Close-up low angle looking through dense, sharp blackthorn branches onto the cracked, frozen soil.
E14.B001 [00:00.50-00:05.50] ACTION: Juliana's blood-streaked, mud-caked hand slowly uncurls amidst the thorns, revealing the ornate emerald signet ring resting in her palm.
E14.B002 [00:01.00-00:05.50] SFX: Eerie cold wind whistling over the briars with deep, atmospheric cello chords.
E14.B003 [00:05.60-00:09.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana stepping out from the briar patch, her cloak torn, cheeks scratched, holding the ring outward with unwavering resolve.
E14.B004 [00:07.70-00:09.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Exhausted, Resolute): I found it.
E14.B005 [00:09.50-00:13.50] CAMERA: Wide shot of Juliana holding the ring out toward the austere Police Constable standing guard beside the frozen garden.
E14.B006 [00:10.50-00:12.70] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Firm, Commanding): Now release my husband.
E14.B007 [00:12.50-00:13.50] ACTION: The Constable takes the ring from her bloodied fingers.
E14.B008 [00:13.50-00:15.50] CAMERA: Tight shot on the iron shackles locking Alexander's wrists together against the thorny backdrop.
E14.B009 [00:14.20-00:15.40] SFX: Sharp metallic click and clinking rattle of heavy iron handcuffs unlocking and falling away.
E14.B010 [00:14.50-00:15.60] ACTION: The Constable unlocks the cuffs, freeing Alexander's large hands.
E14.B011 [00:15.60-00:18.50] CAMERA: Tracking shot as Alexander lunges forward without hesitation, rushing past the Constable straight to Juliana.
E14.B012 [00:16.80-00:18.00] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Gasping, Urgent): Juliana.
E14.B013 [00:18.50-00:23.00] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's rugged hands tenderly grasping Juliana's bloodied, lacerated hands, turning them over with immense care.
E14.B014 [00:18.80-00:23.00] ACTION: Alexander gently turns her palms up, his thumbs trembling as he inspects the deep, bleeding gashes gouged into her skin.
E14.B015 [00:23.00-00:25.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's agonized, furious expression as he stares at her wounds.
E14.B016 [00:23.10-00:25.00] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Trembling, Heartbroken): What have they done to you?
E14.B017 [00:25.50-00:29.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's pale, tear-streaked face looking back into his eyes with tender relief.
E14.B018 [00:26.50-00:28.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Softly, Stifling Pain): Nothing they didn't promise.
E14.B019 [00:29.50-00:32.50] CAMERA: Medium profile two-shot of Alexander and Juliana gazing into each other's eyes amidst the cold mist.
E14.B020 [00:29.80-00:32.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Faint, Pleading): Take me home.
E14.B021 [00:32.50-00:38.50] CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot as Alexander effortlessly scoops Juliana into his arms, gathering her up against his chest.
E14.B022 [00:33.20-00:37.00] ACTION: Alexander lifts Juliana bridal-style, wrapping his strong arms protectively around her as she rests against his shoulder.
E14.B023 [00:35.80-00:38.50] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Deep, Sorrowful): You should never have had to bleed for me.
E14.B024 [00:38.50-00:40.50] CAMERA: Medium tracking shot behind stone balustrades as Alexander carries Juliana past the foggy estate grounds.
E14.B025 [00:40.50-00:43.50] CAMERA: Wide establishing shot of the humble stone cottage standing isolated beneath dark, overcast stormy skies on a rain-slicked dirt road.
E14.B026 [00:40.50-00:43.50] SFX: Gentle patter of rain and cold wind howling in the desolate countryside.
E14.B027 [00:43.50-00:47.00] CAMERA: Warm interior wide shot in front of a roaring hearth fire. Juliana sits on a wooden chair while Alexander kneels on the floor before her, a washbasin of water between them.
E14.B028 [00:44.00-00:47.00] ACTION: Alexander gently wraps clean linen bandages around Juliana's torn wrist and palm.
E14.B029 [00:44.00-00:47.50] SFX: Crackling flames and wood popping in the open fireplace.
E14.B030 [00:47.00-00:50.50] CAMERA: Intimate over-the-shoulder close-up looking up into Juliana's face from Alexander's perspective.
E14.B031 [00:47.20-00:49.80] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Hoarse, Stricken): You could have lost your hands.
E14.B032 [00:50.50-00:55.50] CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's glistening eyes and trembling lips, firelight reflecting softly across her face.
E14.B033 [00:51.80-00:54.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Whispered, Emotional): But I didn't lose you.
E14.B034 [00:55.50-00:58.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's scarred, weathered fingers wrapping the cloth tightly yet gently around her lacerations.
E14.B035 [00:58.50-01:00.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander looking up at her with profound remorse and affection.
E14.B036 [00:58.50-01:00.00] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Quiet, Tender): I'm sorry.
E14.B037 [01:00.50-01:03.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana smiling faintly through her tears, shaking her head.
E14.B038 [01:00.50-01:02.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Gentle, Reassuring): You didn't hurt me.
E14.B039 [01:03.50-01:06.00] CAMERA: Side profile close-up of Alexander lowering his head solemnly in front of her.
E14.B040 [01:06.00-01:10.50] CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Alexander gently drapes a heavy warm woolen blanket across Juliana's lap and around her shoulders.
E14.B041 [01:06.00-01:07.40] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Loving, Earnest): You have taken my place today.
E14.B042 [01:07.50-01:09.80] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Continuing): And you are doing it better than me.
E14.B043 [01:10.50-01:16.00] CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest; he embraces her tightly against him, cradling her head under his chin.
E14.B044 [01:11.00-01:16.00] ACTION: Juliana closes her eyes in exhausted relief, sinking into Alexander's warmth as his broad arm encloses her safely.
E14.B045 [01:16.00-01:23.50] CAMERA: Tight close-up of Alexander holding Juliana against his bearded cheek, kissing the crown of her head before gently cradling her jaw in his scarred hand.
E14.B046 [01:16.50-01:21.00] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Dark, Solemn Vow): No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again.
E14.B047 [01:21.20-01:23.50] ACTION: Alexander strokes her cheek with his thumb, his gaze hardening into deadly, protective conviction.
E14.B048 [01:23.50-01:27.63] CAMERA: Low-angle shot focusing down on two wooden buckets on the stone floor—one filled with dark, blood-soaked wash water reflecting the fireplace.
E14.B049 [01:24.00-01:27.00] ACTION: Alexander's muscular arm drops into frame beside the bloody bucket; his scarred knuckles slowly and tightly clench into an iron fist of brewing vengeance.
E14.B050 [01:24.50-01:27.63] SFX: Ominous, resonating low bass boom swelling into sudden silence as the screen cuts to black.

WHAT TO MARK
HOOK_ANCHOR - a beat that would stop a stranger's thumb if it were the first 3 seconds of a clip:
  a physical shock (slap, shove, grab, collapse, weapon), a line that lands as an accusation, insult,
  threat or confession, or a sudden reveal of identity or betrayal. Scenery, establishing shots, entrances
  without conflict and polite talk are never hooks.
  hook_intensity: 10 = impossible to scroll past, 7 = strong, 4 = mild curiosity. Do not list anything below 4.
CLIFFHANGER_ANCHOR - a beat where tension peaks and is left open: a secret about to come out, an
  ultimatum, a threat, an interrupted action, someone unexpected appearing, a question nobody answers yet.
  If the beats that follow quickly answer or defuse it, give it a lower cliffhanger_tension.
  cliffhanger_tension: 10 = unbearable not to know what happens next. Do not list anything below 4.

RULES
- Use beat_ids exactly as printed above. Never invent beats, lines or events.
- excerpt: copy 4-20 consecutive words VERBATIM from that beat's text.
- Prefer DIALOGUE and ACTION beats. Mark a CAMERA beat only when the jolt is purely visual.
- At most 6 hook anchors and 6 cliffhanger anchors. Fewer is fine. Spread them over
  different moments of the episode instead of marking neighbouring beats of the same moment.
- device (hooks): one or two words, e.g. slap, reveal, insult, threat, confession, humiliation, collapse.
- open_question (cliffhangers): the question the viewer is left with, in under 15 words.
